reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Execution and certification of certificate of organization
headings.reviewNote: Officers execute and file certificate certifying subscribers, paid/unpaid stock, depositary funds, and management personnel.

headings.title: Mandatory accompanying depositary certificate and bylaws
headings.reviewNote: Certificate of organization must be accompanied by bank depositary certificate and adopted corporate bylaws or resolutions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed certificate of organization execution/5 certifications and accompanying depositary certificate and bylaws/resolutions.

headings.title: Board determinations and certificate of incorporation issuance
headings.reviewNote: State banking and savings and loan board determines public necessity, ten paid stockholders, $25,000 cash, and conforming bylaws.

headings.title: Endorsement and return of approved articles
headings.reviewNote: Director of finance returns endorsed articles to applicants certifying issuance of certificate of incorporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed state banking and savings and loan board determinations ($25,000 paid-in no-par stock, 10+ holders) and endorsed articles return.

headings.title: Commencement of corporate existence and conclusive effect
headings.reviewNote: Corporate existence begins upon issuance; certificate conclusive evidence of incorporation except against the state.

headings.title: County recording in recorder of deeds office
headings.reviewNote: Endorsed copy of articles must be recorded in recorder of deeds office in county of principal office.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed corporate existence commencement, conclusive certificate effect except against state, and county recorder of deeds filing.

headings.title: Mandatory provisions in articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Eight mandatory clauses: distinctive name, purpose, duration, office, capital stock minimum (250 shares / $100), 15+ directors, and incorporators.

headings.title: Enumeration of statutory corporate powers unnecessary
headings.reviewNote: Express statutory corporate powers need not be recited in articles of incorporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 8 mandatory articles of incorporation items (250+ no-par shares at $100, 15+ directors) and omission of enumerated statutory powers.

headings.title: Stockholder approval of articles amendment
headings.reviewNote: Articles of incorporation may be amended by majority vote of stockholders at regular or special meeting.

headings.title: Execution, administrative approval, and recording of amendment
headings.reviewNote: Officers execute articles of amendment; takes effect upon approval of board and issuance of certificate by director of finance.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed majority stockholder amendment vote, officer execution, board approval, recording, and director certificate effective date.

headings.title: First annual meeting and capital threshold
headings.reviewNote: First annual meeting held after $25,000 capital stock is paid into corporate treasury; bylaws govern call of meetings.

headings.title: Stockholder voting and cumulative voting rights
headings.reviewNote: Stockholders vote on directors with one vote per share owned; grants cumulative voting rights in director elections.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed first annual meeting after $25,000 paid-in capital, one-vote-per-share rule, and cumulative voting for directors.

headings.title: Board composition and congressional district representation
headings.reviewNote: Initial board elected by incorporators (9+); subsequent board (15+ Missouri residents) with 1 to 2 directors per congressional district.

headings.title: Filling of director vacancies by remaining board
headings.reviewNote: Remaining directors authorized to elect qualified person to fill board vacancy until next annual stockholder meeting.

headings.title: Director tenure until successor qualification
headings.reviewNote: Directors hold office until their successors are elected and qualified.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed initial 9+ board and subsequent 15+ resident board with 1–2 directors per congressional district, vacancy filling, and holdover tenure.

headings.title: Application and board acceptance of membership
headings.reviewNote: Financial institutions become members upon application and formal acceptance by board of directors.

headings.title: Eligible categories of financial institutions
headings.reviewNote: Illustrative categories include banks, trust companies, savings and loans, pensions, insurers, and investment entities.

headings.title: Mandatory loan commitments and institutional limits
headings.reviewNote: Member lending commitments based on capital/surplus formulas (2% for banks, insurers, surety; division rules for savings and loans).

headings.title: Rounding of loan commitment limits
headings.reviewNote: Loan limits established to nearest thousand dollars computed from actual formula amount.

headings.title: Proration of corporate loan calls among members
headings.reviewNote: Prorates committed loan funds ("cash for funds" verbatim in source) among members in proportion to individual commitments.

headings.title: Sixty-day advance notice for member withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Member may withdraw upon 60 days advance written notice, remaining liable only for preexisting commitments.

headings.title: Evidence of indebtedness and minimum interest rate
headings.reviewNote: Member loans evidenced by transferable notes/bonds bearing interest at prime plus at least one-fourth percent.

headings.title: Legal investment status and legal loan limits
headings.reviewNote: Corporate obligations proper investments for members; membership loan limit deducted from legal lending limits.

headings.title: Temporary lending agreements with financial institutions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes subsection 2 financial institutions with credit agreements to lend temporarily within aggregate available limits; notes mature within one year.

headings.title: Separate interest contracts on non-membership borrowings
headings.reviewNote: Permits corporation and members to contract for different interest rates on non-membership borrowings.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 10 subsections and Effective 7-06-94 note against archived text; refined subsection (9) title to cover subsection 2 financial institutions with credit agreements and retained verbatim "cash for funds" wording in subsection (5).

headings.title: Cole County circuit court equity powers over reorganization
headings.reviewNote: Cole County circuit court authority to order meetings of creditors, members, or shareholders on proposed compromise or plan.

headings.title: Voting approval thresholds and binding effect of plan
headings.reviewNote: Plan binding when approved by two-thirds of creditors, majority of stock classes, two-thirds of member notes, and court.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed Cole County circuit court equity power to order reorganization meetings and two-thirds creditor/member and majority stock class approval thresholds.

headings.title: Stockholder authorization of corporate dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Majority stockholder vote to dissolve permitted only after full payment/deposit of all bonds and obligations.

headings.title: Certificate of dissolution and administrative approval
headings.reviewNote: Officers execute certificate; dissolution effective upon approval by state banking board and director endorsement.

headings.title: Corporate continuation for winding up and litigation
headings.reviewNote: Corporation continues after dissolution to discharge liabilities, collect and liquidate assets, and sue/be sued.

headings.title: Pro rata distribution of remaining assets
headings.reviewNote: Surplus assets remaining after satisfaction of all liabilities distributed pro rata among stockholders.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed majority stockholder dissolution after bond payment/deposit, board approval/director endorsement, winding-up continuation, and pro rata distribution.
